translation.name: Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley
translation.summary: A long-running food alley near Seoul Forest known for Korean-style grilled ribs and an older local atmosphere.
translation.description: Seongsu-dong Galbi Alley developed around a cluster of galbi restaurants and offers a very different mood from Seongsu's newer cafes and concept stores. It is useful for travelers who want a traditional local meal within walking distance of Seoul Forest.
translation.local_tip: Meal times can be busy. Visit before the main lunch or dinner rush if you prefer a quieter experience.
